Lunch at Grandma's: 在奶奶家包饺子的快乐周末。
Every Saturday, Tim has lunch at Grandma's house. Grandma always cooks something nice.
Today, Grandma teaches Tim to make dumplings. First, they mix the meat and vegetables. Then, Grandma shows him how to put the mix in the middle of a small piece of dough and close it.
Tim's dumplings look funny. Some are big, and some are small. But they taste great! Grandpa says they are the best dumplings in the world. Tim wants to come again next Saturday.
